crossRefs.note: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.
On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun,

people.name: Eliab
people.line: Son of Helon, leader of the tribe of Zebulun

people.name: Helon
people.line: Father of Eliab, a leader from the tribe of Zebulun.

people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.
translations.bsb: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.
translations.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
translations.asv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
